title: Zelensky Proposes Istanbul Summit with Trump and Putin
detail: In a CNN Türk interview in Istanbul, Zelensky said he is ready to meet Putin and Trump there, with Türkiye as mediator. He described technical talks in Abu Dhabi (energy and maritime ceasefires, prisoner exchanges) and a leaders' meeting as parallel tracks, and said the priority is a ceasefire along the current line of contact. No Russian response is recorded in the source.
